question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a black ball, Dave has a blue ball, Eve has a teal ball, Fred has a red ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Fred and Bob swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Finally, Fred and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) brown ball
(C) black ball
(D) blue ball
(E) teal ball
(F) red ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: (green, brown, black, blue, teal, red, gold)
1. Dave and Gertrude swap: (green, brown, black, gold, teal, red, blue)
2. Fred and Bob swap: (green, red, black, gold, teal, brown, blue)
3. Bob and Dave swap: (green, gold, black, red, teal, brown, blue)
4. Eve and Dave swap: (green, gold, black, teal, red, brown, blue)
5. Claire and Alice swap: (black, gold, green, teal, red, brown, blue)
6. Dave and Bob swap: (black, teal, green, gold, red, brown, blue)
7. Fred and Alice swap: (brown, teal, green, gold, red, black, blue)
Bob has the teal ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
